scope: 单张作品提取；印刷媒介与工艺未核。原图署名按画面转录，原始发表出处与公开转载权限待核。

references.R1: 用户提供的端午海报 PNG，1080 × 1440，画面底款标注 AIGC Digital Art 和 inxi-pic。 归档文件 reference.png。
references.R1-top: 上部薄荷绿、淡桃和米黄色的波带与纸底间隙。
references.R1-buildings: 中段由左下往右上抬升的屋檐群、不同图案的墙面及渐隐的柱脚。
references.R1-action: 下三分之一的细长龙舟、队员姿态、斜桨、旗鼓和零散水纹。
references.R1-paper: 全图暖白纤维状纸纹以及网点在色场和建筑墙面中的分布。
references.R1-footer: 下缘左对齐的小字号双语说明区。

slots.setting: 沿斜线递进的主环境结构
slots.foreground: 在下部横向展开的活动场景
slots.gesture: 参与者反复出现的姿态或方向
slots.atmosphere: 顶端低对比的宽形气氛色带
slots.patterns: 随结构变化的装饰图案
slots.label: 在下端出现的短文案

captioned.en: the theme calls for a footer

rules.zh: 在暖白纸面上表现民俗节庆插画，将{{setting}}的高密装饰与{{foreground}}的简练动作并置，保留颗粒印刷观感。
rules.en: Make a folk-festival illustration on warm ivory paper, pairing the dense ornament of {{setting}} with the simplified action of {{foreground}} and a grainy printed appearance.
rules.check: 缩略观看仍能辨认建筑或场景层、人物活动层和纸面留空。

rules.zh: 用暖白纸色占据大面积。高饱和玫红和鲜绿集中在主结构；蜜桃色为暖色过渡，淡黄、薄荷绿负责轻柔气氛，炭黑只出现在小人剪影和文字。
rules.en: Let warm ivory paper occupy much of the composition. Concentrate vivid magenta and fresh green on the main structure; use peach as a warm transition, pale yellow and mint for a light atmosphere, and charcoal for small silhouettes and text only.
rules.check: 玫红和鲜绿集中在主形，远端色带和留纸更安静。

rules.zh: 用均匀明亮的漫射观感；以留纸、浅色和局部深色边沿暗示受光与叠压。保持暗部小而薄。
rules.en: Use a bright, even diffuse appearance; suggest light and layering with exposed paper, pale colors, and a few dark edges. Keep dark areas small and shallow.
rules.check: 主要明暗通过墨色密度和留纸形成，地面没有重投影。

rules.zh: 让{{setting}}从左下向右上形成有节奏的阶梯斜向；{{foreground}}横向铺在下部。顶部以{{atmosphere}}带入画面，底部保留整片纸色。
rules.en: Give {{setting}} a stepped rhythm climbing from lower left to upper right; arrange {{foreground}} horizontally below. Lead in from the top with {{atmosphere}} and leave a broad paper-colored area at the bottom.
rules.check: 能指出斜向骨架、横向行动带与连续留白。

rules.zh: 让参与者明显小于主环境结构，但保留剪影、服色和清楚的动作。
rules.en: Make participants visibly smaller than the main setting while preserving legible silhouettes, clothing colors and actions.
rules.check: 缩略图中人群是次级焦点，放大后能辨认动作。

rules.zh: 用分色平面和精选细线建形。{{patterns}}只在有结构的分区内重复，小人用平涂剪影与有方向的肢体。
rules.en: Build forms with separated flat colors and selective fine lines. Repeat {{patterns}} within clearly structured areas and draw small figures as flat silhouettes with directional limbs.
rules.check: 细线、色形和重复纹样各自清楚，人物不依赖肖像级细节。

rules.zh: 保留主结构上沿的清晰彩边，下面的柱脚或色面逐步疏开，借稀网点、破边、停笔接回纸底。
rules.en: Keep crisp colored edges along the upper structures. Let lower bases and planes open out into sparse halftone, broken edges and unfinished strokes, merging back into the paper.
rules.check: 上部轮廓完整，下端可看到颜料疏开至纸白。

rules.zh: 把细节留给主结构转角和重复动作，地面、远处与文案周围只留少量记号。
rules.en: Reserve detail for turns in the main structures and repeated actions. Keep ground, distant areas and surroundings of the text to a few marks.
rules.check: 精细区局部集中，大片低密区域连贯。

rules.zh: 在不同区域分别用浅纸纤维、颜料细颗粒和可辨规则网点。以点的疏密和大小组织局部色阶，让少量干边自然露纸。
rules.en: Use pale paper fibers, fine pigment grain, and visible regular halftone dots in different areas. Adjust dot size and spacing for local tonal steps and leave a few dry edges exposing the paper.
rules.check: 能分别辨认无墨纸纹、均匀微颗粒和局部规律网点。

rules.zh: 用{{gesture}}建立节庆活动的动作节奏。安排少量主题道具，让道具、参与者和场地的关系可以一眼读懂。
rules.en: Use {{gesture}} as the rhythm of the festival activity. Place a small number of themed props so their relation to participants and setting reads at a glance.
rules.check: 姿态有一致走向，关键道具归属清楚。

rules.zh: 高密度集中于主结构饰带和活动动作。顶边低对比，中段纸白穿插进结构，底部安静。
rules.en: Concentrate detail in the main ornament and festival gestures. Keep the top low-contrast, let paper gaps enter the middle structure, and keep the bottom quiet.
rules.check: 标题和动作附近仍有纸白，网点不会填满整张图。

rules.zh: 先让读者看见玫红与鲜绿构成的主结构，再让视线落到小人物。需要落款时，把{{label}}放在左下的清晰纸面，字号从属。
rules.en: Draw the eye first to the magenta-and-green structure and then to the small figures. For a captioned work, place {{label}} low on clear paper at the left in subordinate type.
rules.check: 文字低调且可辨，主结构和小人物之间的焦点顺序仍成立。

rules.zh: 用宏大的斜向装饰结构对照轻巧的横向人群，用高饱和局部对照安静纸白，呈现轻盈、热闹的民俗气氛。
rules.en: Contrast a large diagonal ornamental structure with a light horizontal group, and pockets of vivid color with quiet ivory paper, for a lively yet airy festival mood.
rules.check: 大与小、浓与淡、斜向与横向三组对照可辨。
